question: GQ-001
subject: a 437s suite I could not honestly speed up
the_goal: get gate-selftest.sh onto the pre-push hook by making it fast enough to run there

my_hypothesis_was_wrong.thought: it replays the full 8-gate chain 15 times
my_hypothesis_was_wrong.measured: it already invokes single gates — 10 cases call audit-asserted-numbers.mjs directly
my_hypothesis_was_wrong.so: the cost is one gate, not chain replay

where_the_time_actually_is.the_dominant_query: select count(*) from passage on 41.5M rows — 15,301ms, 61% of it
where_the_time_actually_is.vault_queries: 1,411ms — NOT the problem, despite my earlier warning about USB

a_fast_answer_i_refused.what: max(rowid) returns 41501325 in 4ms; count(*) returns 41501325 in 15,301ms
a_fast_answer_i_refused.why_refused: rowids gap the moment a row is deleted, so max(rowid) would silently overstate. A correct slow answer beats a fast one that can lie.

the_cache_that_was_a_lie.what_actually_happened: sqliteCache was REFERENCED on three lines and declared nowhere. The ReferenceError made the audit skip work rather than do it faster. node --check passes on this — an undeclared identifier is only an error when the line executes.
the_cache_that_was_a_lie.then_i_measured_whether_a_cache_CAN_help: 11 sqlite derivations, 11 DISTINCT (uri, query) pairs — nothing repeats, so a cache can never hit
the_cache_that_was_a_lie.outcome: REMOVED, with the reasoning kept in the file so nobody re-adds it

result.gate_selftest: 367s, stays out of the pre-push hook
result.net_change: one dead cache removed, one latent ReferenceError fixed, timings documented

what_i_did_not_achieve: the self-test still cannot run on every push. I found no honest way to make it faster, and I am recording that rather than shipping max(rowid).
